features.description: List of product features and bullet points (JSON array)

inStock.description: Whether the product is currently in stock

locationText.description: Delivery destination the product detail page rendered for

lowestOfferPrice.description: Lowest "More Buying Choices" offer price (JSON object with value and currency)

starsBreakdown.description: Rating breakdown by star count (JSON object), from the product detail page

sustainabilityFeatures.description: Sustainability/Climate Pledge Friendly badge labels (JSON array)

variantAsins.description: List of variant product ASINs (JSON array)
